system.description:
May be added to a polearm, axe or spear. Weapon length is as the weapon it is fitted to; adjust the length to suit. Modifications cost +1 rp per weapon (+4 rps for superior quality weapons).

Run of the Mill Arms cost 5 rps for the character's whole idiom of hand weapons (e.g. sword, lance and dagger for a knight).

Source: Burning Wheel Gold Revised, p. 555
